purpose.claim: We begin with the life your child is working toward. That purpose guides abilities, goals, therapies, people, everyday practice and review.

links.label: Why your child’s life comes first

measurement.claim: We bring professional assessment, AbilityScore® measurement and your observations together to understand the starting point and agree meaningful goals.

review.claim: We review where your child uses an ability, how much support helps and what needs to change next. PinnacleAI supports tracking and review; people guide the decisions.

practice.claim: We help your family turn agreed goals into manageable practice in familiar routines and bring your observations into review.

links.label: Parent resources by Sreeja Reddy Saripalli

software.claim: PinnacleAI GPT-OS v1.0.0 is Class B non-diagnostic developmental-support software for children aged 0–12. The MD-5 intended functions include ability measurement, readiness tracking, progress forecasting and adaptive therapy-plan support.

links.label: Named modules in the BIS schedule

research.claim: Explore the work behind Pinnacle’s developmental approach, with original publications, authors and research status. The library separates preliminary findings, planned studies and company-published summaries.

quality.claim: We publish our quality-management and information-security certificates with their named system scopes and review dates.
